Actually the rulebook matched "intermittent" with "Long-run power cycling test". So targeted true with that test name.

Safety: melted fuse box, no fire reported in narrative. No risk to people shown → safety_relevant false. The recalls about headliner fires are different component... but the fuse melting could be fire risk; narrative doesn't show a risk to people. Keep false.

Clues quotes must be verbatim from narrative. Note the narrative uses "The contact stated that while attempting to start the vehicle, the vehicle failed to start as intended." Verbatim spans: "the vehicle failed to start as intended" ok. "an intermittent warning light for EVAP failure was illuminated" — narrative says "an intermittent warning light for EVAP failure was illuminated" yes. "the fuel pump fuse was blown and had melted into the fuse box" yes. "intermittent" yes. Component quote "ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:FUSES AND CIRCUIT BREAKERS" — narrative doesn't include that; it's metadata. Extraction included it but narrative doesn't. Avoid, or risk drop. Skip.

Safety false, targeted true, test_name "Long-run power cycling test".
